title: Ethiopian Yeast Flatbread
description: A traditional Ethiopian flatbread made with yeast that is perfect for wrapping up your favorite fillings.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine yeast and warm water. Let it sit for 5 minutes until it becomes frothy.
Add flour, salt, almond milk, and Ethiopian spices to the bowl. Mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
Divide the dough into 4-6 equal pieces, depending on how large you want your flatbreads to be.
Roll out each piece into a ball and then flatten it slightly into a disk shape.
Place a flatbread in the pan and cook for 1-2 minutes on each side until it's golden brown and puffed up.
Serve the flatbreads warm with your favorite fillings.
